aubergine--noun.def: A long purple vegetable, called eggplant in America.

balky--adj.def: Refusing to move or to work properly.
balky--adj.ex: The balky engine would not start.

beautify--verb.def: To make a place look more attractive.
beautify--verb.ex: They beautified the square with trees.

bewilderment--noun.def: The state of being completely confused.

biotechnology--noun.def: The use of living cells in industry and medicine.

bookish--adj.def: More interested in books than in other activities.
bookish--adj.ex: He was a quiet bookish child.

burdensome--adj.def: Causing a lot of work or worry.

burgle--verb.def: To enter a building illegally in order to steal.
burgle--verb.ex: Their house was burgled last month.

carbon-dioxide--noun.def: The gas that people breathe out and plants take in.

carbon-footprint--noun.def: The amount of harmful gas a person or a company produces.

carbon-monoxide--noun.def: A poisonous gas with no smell made by burning fuel.
carbon-monoxide--noun.ex: A detector warns of carbon monoxide.

categorization--noun.def: The act of putting things into groups by type.

cheerfulness--noun.def: The quality of being happy and positive.

clearness--noun.def: The quality of being easy to see or to understand.
clearness--noun.ex: The clearness of the water surprised us.

climate-change--noun.def: The long-term warming of the earth's weather.

coherence--noun.def: The quality of fitting together in a logical way.

collocation--noun.def: Two words that are often used together.
collocation--noun.ex: Heavy rain is a common collocation.
collocation--noun.exTr: Heavy rain yaygın bir eş dizimdir.

communicative--adj.def: Willing to talk and share information.
communicative--adj.ex: The class uses a communicative method.

conferencing--noun.def: Holding meetings by telephone or video.

coziness--noun.def: The warm comfortable feeling of a small room.
coziness--noun.ex: The coziness of the kitchen drew us in.

crystallize--verb.def: To form crystals, or to become clear in the mind.

cubism--noun.def: An art style that shows objects as geometric shapes.

cursor--noun.def: The small mark on a screen showing where you are typing.
cursor--noun.ex: Move the cursor to the box.

cyberaddict--noun.def: A person who cannot stop using the internet.

cybercafe--noun.def: A shop where you pay to use a computer.
cybercafe--noun.ex: We printed it at a cybercafe.

cybercrime--noun.exTr: Siber suç bankalara milyonlara mal oluyor.

cyberpet--noun.def: An electronic toy animal that you look after.
cyberpet--noun.exTr: Sanal evcil hayvanın her gün beslenmesi gerekiyor.

cyberschool--noun.def: A school where lessons happen over the internet.

de-facto--adj.def: Existing in fact, though not legally recognized.
de-facto--adj.ex: He is the de facto leader.

debit-card--noun.def: A card that takes money straight from your account.

deforestation--noun.def: The cutting down of forests over a large area.

dehumanize--verb.def: To treat people as if they were not human.
dehumanize--verb.exTr: Savaş iki tarafı da insanlıktan çıkarabilir.

determiner--noun.def: A word such as the or some used before a noun.
determiner--noun.ex: Circle the determiner in each line.
determiner--noun.exTr: Her satırdaki belirteci daire içine al.

dispensable--adj.def: Not necessary and able to be given up.

doorkeeper--noun.def: A person who guards the entrance to a building.

downsize--verb.def: To reduce the number of workers in a company.

drapery--noun.def: Cloth hung in folds, especially in art or on a stage.

drinkable--adj.def: Safe or pleasant enough to drink.

duplication--noun.def: The act of doing or copying something twice.

ecologically--adv.def: In a way relating to nature and the environment.

ecologist--noun.def: A scientist who studies living things and their surroundings.

entitle--verb.def: To give someone the right to something.
entitle--verb.ex: The ticket entitles you to one drink.
entitle--verb.exTr: Bilet sana bir içecek hakkı veriyor.

environmentally-friendly--adj.def: Not harmful to the natural world.

essayist--noun.def: A writer of short pieces on a subject.

exactness--noun.def: The quality of being completely correct.
exactness--noun.ex: The exactness of the copy impressed us.

examinee--noun.def: A person who is taking an examination.
examinee--noun.exTr: Her sınava girene bir saat veriliyor.

exclamation-mark--noun.def: The mark written after a strong statement.
exclamation-mark--noun.ex: Do not use an exclamation mark here.

exultant--adj.def: Very happy because of a success.
exultant--adj.exTr: Sevinç içindeki kalabalık birlikte şarkı söyledi.

fed-up--adj.def: Annoyed and tired of a situation.
fed-up--adj.ex: I am fed up with the delays.

ferryboat--noun.def: A boat that carries people and cars across water.

fire-brigade--noun.def: The organization that puts out fires.
fire-brigade--noun.ex: Call the fire brigade at once.

first-language--noun.def: The language a person learns first as a child.

first-person--noun.def: The form of a verb used with the word I.
first-person--noun.ex: The story is told in the first person.

flexibly--adv.def: In a way that can change to suit conditions.

fluency--noun.def: The ability to speak a language easily and well.

functionality--noun.def: The range of things a machine or a program can do.

furor--noun.def: A sudden outburst of public anger.

generalization--noun.def: A broad statement that may not be true in every case.

generalize--verb.def: To make a broad statement from a few examples.
generalize--verb.ex: Do not generalize from one case.

global-warming--noun.def: The rise in the earth's temperature over time.
global-warming--noun.ex: Global warming is melting the ice.

glocal--adj.def: Combining what is global with what is local.
glocal--adj.ex: The brand takes a glocal approach.

gracefulness--noun.def: Beauty in the way someone moves.
gracefulness--noun.ex: The gracefulness of her dance stayed with us.

graphically--adv.def: In a very clear and detailed way.

guideline--noun.def: A rule that advises how something should be done.

gymnastic--adj.def: Relating to exercises needing strength and balance.

habitant--noun.def: A person who lives in a particular place.

handicraft--noun.def: Skilled work made by hand, such as weaving.

handrail--noun.def: A bar you hold when going up or down stairs.
handrail--noun.ex: Hold the handrail on the steps.

hard-drive--noun.def: The part of a computer that stores data.
hard-drive--noun.ex: The hard drive is nearly full.

health-care--noun.def: The services that keep people healthy.
health-care--noun.ex: Health care is free for children.

hospitalize--verb.def: To take someone into hospital for treatment.

housemaster--noun.def: A teacher in charge of a boarding house at a school.
housemaster--noun.exTr: Sorumlu öğretmen her odayı kontrol etti.

human-rights--noun.def: The basic rights every person should have.

humanize--verb.def: To make something kinder and more suitable for people.
